claim.subject: AirLLM (lyogavin/airllm) headline capability claim
claim.text: AirLLM lets you run a 70B large language model on a single 4GB GPU - and a 2.8T model in its headline configuration - by layer-by-layer inference with optional 4/8-bit compression.
